controllingCorrections.rule: The original 3-lb trigger frame and original 2-lb working striker/discharge block are primary and must survive in recoverable form. The 2-lb captive spring/actuation member and separate subordinate contacts, supports, catches, grip covers, fittings and feet may be replaced with actual compatible stock through the applicable restoration procedure. Contacts do not replace the primary discharge block. Preserve the same trap identity, original primaries, 12 × 12 × 3-inch envelope, 8-lb empty mass and 3/2/2/1-lb allocation. A missing/nonfunctional spring prevents discharge until repair is complete. Positive-HP repair uses DC10, max(1 hour, recorded maximumHP/10 hours) and 2.50 gp material reference; HP0 uses the original recipe DC, max(8 hours, maximumHP/10 hours) and 25% of the existing finished-unit reference. Actual trained Tinker's tools, INT, station, implements, compatible stock and completed work remain necessary. No spring replacement refills charges, services the trap, resets arming/command/offense/custody history, removes flaws or reverses terminal dismantling. Original-actuator requirements for automaton chassis and other bodies are unchanged.
